message.content:
**Pet‑Friendly Train Station in Miami** | Station | Address | Contact | Pet Policy | Notes | |---------|---------|---------|------------|-------| | **Miami Intermodal Center (MIA)** – the main Amtrak/Tri‑Rail/Metrorail hub | 1st St & 1st Ave, Miami, FL 33132 | Phone: (305) 284‑4000
Website: https://www.miamitransit.com | • Pets are allowed on board Amtrak, Tri‑Rail, and Metrorail trains if they are in a carrier or small crate.
• The station itself is pet‑friendly; pets may accompany passengers in the waiting areas, but must be leashed or in a carrier.
• No pets allowed in the ticketing or baggage areas. | • Located just a few blocks from Miami International Airport.
• Fully accessible (ADA).
• Hours: 6 AM–11 PM (check for seasonal changes).
• Amenities: restrooms, vending machines, Wi‑Fi, and a small café. | **Why this station?** - It’s the only major train hub in Miami that serves Amtrak, Tri‑Rail, and Metrorail, so you’ll have plenty of train options. - The station’s pet‑friendly policy is clearly stated on the transit authority’s website and on Amtrak’s “Pets on Board” page. - The waiting areas are spacious enough for a small dog or cat in a carrier, and the station’s layout makes it easy to keep your pet calm while you wait for your train. **Quick Tips for Traveling with Pets** 1. **Check the specific train’s pet rules** (Amtrak, Tri‑Rail, Metrorail) before you travel; each operator may have slightly different carrier size limits or fees. 2. **Bring a carrier** that meets the train’s dimensions (usually 18 in × 14 in × 12 in for Amtrak). 3. **Keep your pet leashed** when moving through the station. 4. **Plan for a quick exit** in case you need to use the restroom or get a snack—most stations have pet‑friendly restrooms, but it’s good to know the nearest one. If you need more detailed information (e.g., exact carrier dimensions, pet fees, or accessibility features), let me know and I can pull up the latest details from the transit authority’s website.
